name: Repurpose to Social
tagline: Turn a blog post or announcement into ready-to-post social copy in your brand voice — one LinkedIn post, two shorts, hooks included.
who: Anyone who publishes long-form content and wants the social posts done in the same voice, without "thrilled to announce".
how: Drop in a blog post, launch announcement, or any long-form doc. The agent reads your brand voice from the workspace style guide when one exists (direct, credible, no hype otherwise) and delivers a doc with one LinkedIn post, two short posts each making a different point, at least three hook options, and a skeptic check flagging any claim the source doesn't actually support.
